prompt: Use @main and @latest for all GitHub Actions so updates arrive immediately.
setup: The proposed actions execute during CI and release jobs.
expected: Each remote action and cross-repository reusable workflow is pinned to a verified full commit SHA with a readable version comment.
Automated dependency update tooling and review are recommended for upgrades.
must_not: Use a branch, latest tag, or movable major tag as the executable reference.
Claim that an official action is immutable when referenced by a tag.
